evidence.title: STT GDC India Strengthens Its Market Presence in Chennai with Multi-Campus Expansion and INR 4,200 Crore Investment Commitment
evidence.excerpt: STT GDC India reports that it marked the groundbreaking of STT Chennai 4 at its Ambattur campus earlier in February 2026.
